findings.title: Redirected log lines bypass control-byte sanitization
findings.evidence: crates/blit-cli/src/transfers/local.rs:382-383 forwards each backend line unchanged to ProgressBar::println, although sanitize_row_text exists at lines 369-376; crates/blit-core/src/remote/transfer/source.rs:556-557 interpolates a raw relative filename into such a warning.
findings.predicted_failure: On a TTY progress run, an unreadable Unix filename containing a newline or ANSI escape produces extra terminal lines or executes the escape sequence, breaking the single-row display despite the new sanitization.
findings.better_approach: Apply sanitize_row_text to every redirected backend line before passing it to RowOutput::println.

findings.title: Verbose rendering performs blocking terminal I/O inside an async task
findings.evidence: crates/blit-cli/src/transfers/local.rs:386-393 implements RowOutput::println with synchronous ProgressBar::println, and lines 402-424 invoke it directly from drain_progress_lane for every FileComplete event.
findings.predicted_failure: With many files on a slow or backpressured PTY, a terminal write can block a Tokio worker; on a single-worker runtime this stalls transfer futures and timers, potentially hanging the command until the terminal drains.
findings.better_approach: Move ordered indicatif terminal writes to a dedicated blocking task or thread and feed it through a nonblocking channel.

findings.title: The fixed drain deadline can discard requested verbose lines
findings.evidence: crates/blit-cli/src/transfers/local.rs:449-453 aborts the consumer after 500 ms regardless of whether the producer lane has closed, and lines 537-539 apply that deadline on every successful finish while lines 418-424 may still be printing one line per queued completion.
findings.predicted_failure: If a fast small-file transfer leaves more than 500 ms of -v output queued when the session returns, the receiver is aborted and the command exits successfully without printing the remaining per-file completion lines.
findings.better_approach: Fully drain closed lanes on successful sessions and reserve the bounded abort fallback for failed sessions with surviving producer clones.

findings.title: The perf-history change alters and can suppress sink-less diagnostics
findings.evidence: crates/blit-core/src/transfer_session/local.rs:775-779 replaces the former direct verbose stderr message with log::warn; crates/blit-core/src/stderr_log.rs:28-39 filters it through BLIT_LOG and adds the binary/level prefix.
findings.predicted_failure: On a non-TTY verbose run where performance-history persistence fails, stderr now emits a different prefixed/lowercase line, and with BLIT_LOG=error or off emits no diagnostic at all, violating sink-less byte compatibility.
findings.better_approach: Route the legacy preformatted diagnostic through a redirectable stderr-line helper whose no-sink branch emits the original bytes unchanged.
